ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (18) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Представление» (predstavleniye, 'representation') is kept as "representation" in Tolstoy's own thoughts, in the philosophical sense of the word; «внешний мир» (vneshniy mir) is "the external world". Lichtenberg's italics, including «*синяя.*» ('blue') with its period, follow the print.

Source observation: [17] In the closing thought the word «мире» ('world') stands outside the asterisks of an otherwise wholly italic passage («в этом* мире, *неважно»); apparently a markup slip. The English line is italicized throughout.
